column3: “Her own doom” specifies the coming of her time; “walls” specifies her midst.
“To a close” and “the end of” specify days and years.
Using power renders each according to his arm.
The father and menstruating woman are rendered in the plural.
Striking hands together expands striking My palm.
“Courage” renders heart; day is singular instead of plural days.
Self-defilement replaces being profaned through yourself.
Disregarding Sabbaths renders hiding their eyes from them.
“These deeds” supplies the object of whitewashing.
